tokens.name: dt-text-on-scrim
tokens.usage: Text over a darkened photograph. Light in both modes, because a scrim over a photo is dark in both.

tokens.name: dt-text-on-scrim-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text over a darkened photograph.

tokens.name: dt-surface-brand-secondary
tokens.usage: A full-bleed fill in the second brand hue.

tokens.name: dt-surface-brand-secondary-muted
tokens.usage: The pale tint of the second brand hue.

tokens.name: dt-text-brand-secondary
tokens.usage: A word or eyebrow set in the second brand hue.

tokens.name: dt-surface-brand-duotone
tokens.usage: Both brand hues in one sweep. Carries white text.

tokens.name: dt-pattern-size
tokens.usage: The repeat interval for a dot or grid texture.

tokens.name: dt-pattern-ink
tokens.usage: The line or dot colour. Follows the border-strength role, so it adapts to dark mode and a mono theme on its own.

tokens.name: dt-pattern-grid
tokens.value: linear-gradient(var(--dt-pattern-ink) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / var(--dt-pattern-size) var(--dt-pattern-size), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--dt-pattern-ink) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / var(--dt-pattern-size) var(--dt-pattern-size)

tokens.name: dt-surface-texture
tokens.usage: The active choice. Configure or a theme repoints this at one of the two patterns above.
